from collections import Counter, defaultdict
def F_detect(I,O):
    return sorted(set(x for r in I for x in r)-set(x for r in O for x in r))[0]
# Majority-vote variant: use median/most common value over all occurrences per residue? same thing here
def tile_fill_maj(I,vh,hw,F):
    cnt=defaultdict(Counter)
    for r in range(len(I)):
        for c in range(len(I[0])):
            if I[r][c]!=F: cnt[(r%vh,c%hw)][I[r][c]]+=1
    out=[]
    for r in range(len(I)):
        row=[]
        for c in range(len(I[0])):
            k=(r%vh,c%hw)
            v=cnt[k].most_common()[0][0]
            # fallback from actual neighbor scan when count tie or none
            ups=[I[rr][c] for rr in range(r-1,-1,-1) if I[rr][c]!=F]; downs=[I[rr][c] for rr in range(r+1,len(I)) if I[rr][c]!=F]
            row.append(v if cnt[k][v]>=len(cnt[k])/2 else (ups[0] if ups else (downs[0] if downs else F)))
        out.append(row)
    return out
for i in range(1,9):

    FH=F_detect(di,do)
    m=tile_fill_maj(di,7,8,FH)==do
    print(i,m)
